videos.title: Stars, Stripes, VIPs and Protests: Brussels hosts US Independence bash
videos.transcript: Thousands of guests traveled down to Brussels on Sunday to celebrate the 250th anniversary of US independence. The invite-only event is held in a large park in the Belgian capital, which is located near the EU institutions. >> And everyone gathered in Brussels to celebrate 250 years of American independence. >> US [music] Ambassador to Belgium Bill White opened the ceremony. Among those attending are Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever, NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte, and European [music] Parliament President Roberta Metsola. US military personnel based in the Belgian capital are also in attendance. However, the event drew widespread criticism. On Sunday morning, Greenpeace unrolled a massive banner in the city center condemning the occasion to promote Trump's political and corporate agenda. And several organizations, including Extinction Rebellion and Rise for Climate, demonstrated outside of the park in protest against the privatization of the public park.
videos.summary: Thousands of guests gathered in Brussels on Sunday to celebrate the 250th anniversary of US independence at an invite-only event held in a park near EU institutions. The ceremony was opened by US Ambassador to Belgium Bill White and attended by several high-profile European leaders. At the same time, environmental and climate groups staged protests outside the event.

options: A large park in Brussels near the EU institutions

options: Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever

options: Blocked the entrance to the park

trueFalse.statement: The event in Brussels celebrated 250 years of American independence.

videos.title: South Korea unveils $576 billion AI chip investment
videos.transcript: South Korea rolled out sweeping chip and AI mega projects on Monday. >> President Lee Jang pledged investments worth more than $576 billion over several years. It's a move that aims to cement the nation's overwhelming industry leadership. Lee was joined for the announcement by the leaders of Samsung Electronics and SKH Highix. High bandwidth memory chips produced by both tech giants have become pivotal in the global race to build advanced AI systems. Lee said the world's two largest memory chip makers will invest around 518 billion with suppliers to build two new chip fabrication sites each in South Korea's southwest region. He announced plans for the southwest to host major chip production clusters drawing on abundant underused power. Lee defended these proposed new hubs over the weekend as a national survival strategy to ease regional imbalances and expand capacity for the AI era. Representatives of other firms including LG Electronics and HD Hyundai Robotics also attended.
videos.summary: South Korea has announced a massive investment plan worth over $576 billion in chip and AI development. President Lee Jang made the announcement alongside the leaders of Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, outlining plans to build new chip production facilities in the country's southwest region. The initiative is described as a national strategy to strengthen South Korea's position in the global AI industry.

videos.title: Cost of doing nothing for environment is costly
videos.transcript: We want clean water. We want clean air. We We need healthy soils. And And that is one reason I think we need. And I'm not sure that it always has to cost more money. It's more doing thing more efficiently, using new techniques, using AI, using digitalization. I think that is one part. The other part is that we today again see that dependencies cost. And that is something that me as a consumer at the end of the day is paying the price for. So, we need to treat our environment. We need to get in a a more sustainable way because that is the future proof. So, of course we can discuss and we can put plaster on the things at the moment, but that will only uh postpone the cost. The cost of doing nothing to prevent for flooding, for prevent for for droughts, that is or wildfires, that is costly and it will at the end of the day cost uh me as a consumer money.

Ultimately, the speaker stresses that consumers will end up paying the price if society fails to act sustainably.

videos.title: 'Absolutely freezing' winter storm causes mass power outages in US. #Storm #Weather #BBCNews
videos.transcript: Well, there are not many people out and about as you can imagine this morning. But in other places, southern states for example, people are just having to hang tight. Power has been knocked out. In some states, some people are without ways to heat their homes right now. Other people, they're trying to find some fun where they can. They're out sledging. A few impromptu snowball fights springing up. And that really gets your bonus.
